summary: New briefing added 7 acceptance criteria for the compacted hero thread bridge, restructured 'Other Projects' three-column editorial layout, and grouped 'Currently Exploring' directions. All are UI-facing (no new API surface). Wrote 6 new named browser checks covering the new criteria and re-ran the 8 pre-existing checks (by name only) to confirm no regressions to unrelated structure/interactions. All 14 checks passed.
backend_note: No app-specific backend endpoints back any of the 7 new criteria (portfolio remains static/content-driven); no backend test files were added, consistent with iteration 1.

checks.criterion: Follow the thread remains the exact editorial bridge text but is substantially more compact
checks.name: hero-thread-bridge-compact
checks.evidence: hero-thread-bridge text reads 'Follow the thread: experimentation → engineering → reliability → product thinking' (all required segments present); boundingBox height = 24px; accent line span[aria-hidden] visible; data-reveal attribute present; vertical gap to gap-project-kicker is within a generous 300px bound (well under the near-bottom-edge deviation allowance).

checks.criterion: Other Projects uses a strong three-column editorial composition on desktop
checks.name: other-projects-three-column-desktop
checks.evidence: At 1280px, other-project-1/2/3 titles are exactly 'Habit Tracker', 'TableTennisManager', 'PromoSearch Java' in order with indexes 01/02/03, visible descriptions, and github.com hrefs; bounding boxes show equal y (side-by-side) with increasing x; other-projects-grid class contains 'divide-x' (thin dividers, no divide via cards); zero elements in the section (no images/cards/shadows).

checks.criterion: Other Projects hover and focus states remain restrained and meaningful
checks.name: other-projects-hover-focus-restrained
checks.evidence: Hovering other-project-1-link changes title computed color (teal accent) vs. baseline; borderRadius stays '0px' (no card surface created); keyboard-focusing the link via .focus() also changes title color, confirming both hover and focus states trigger the same restrained accent response.

checks.criterion: Other Projects stacks cleanly on mobile
checks.name: other-projects-mobile-stack
checks.evidence: At 390x844, all 3 project titles/links render in order with matching x (full-width) and strictly increasing y (vertical stack); all hrefs point to github.com; document.scrollWidth <= clientWidth+2 confirms no horizontal overflow.

checks.criterion: Currently Exploring is grouped into three editorial directions
checks.name: exploring-three-grouped-directions
checks.evidence: exploring-direction-1/2/3 titles exactly match 'Native iOS & Product', 'Software Architecture', 'Quality & Reliability' with their specified descriptions; exactly 3 direction-title nodes exist (no leftover six-row layout); exploring-intro trajectory text ('...curious about next') retained and visible; rows carry border-b divider classes with boxShadow 'none' (no card styling).

checks.criterion: Currently Exploring has tighter rhythm and remains responsive
checks.name: exploring-tight-rhythm-responsive
checks.evidence: After scroll-into-view, exploring-title and exploring-direction-1-description computed opacity settle to ~1 (reveal motion complete, nothing clipped/hidden); description boundingBox height>0 with non-empty text. At 390x844 all 3 direction titles/descriptions remain visible and readable with document.scrollWidth <= clientWidth+2 (no overflow).

checks.criterion: All other portfolio structure and interactions remain unchanged
checks.name: reveal-grouped-sections-visible / how-i-build-stage-interaction / gap-flagship-entrance / project-hover-emphasis / nav-active-section-feedback / hero-ambient-pointer-interaction / dark-section-transitions-preserved / mobile-and-reduced-motion-accessible
checks.evidence: All 8 pre-existing iteration-1 browser checks were re-run by name only (persisted scripts, no script re-send) and each PASSED again: scroll reveals, How I Build stage interaction, Gap flagship real screenshots, Project hover emphasis + repo links, Nav active-section feedback, hero ambient pointer line, dark-section transitions (gap/contact), and mobile/reduced-motion accessibility all continue to function identically to before the new changes, with no console/HTTP errors surfaced.
